question: Are the empty regions of the silhouette embedding space occupied by coherent outlines (room for intermediate forms between the recorded ones), and does the dated record change gradually or in jumps?
note: Registered before the decoder was trained or any latent was decoded. A decoder trained on the frozen encoder's latent space is the only generative component; there is no text, date or prior. Decoded outlines are 2D form hypotheses from single uncalibrated photographs; they carry no scale, mechanism, material or function and are not designs. Whether a gap can be filled by a decoded outline says nothing about whether such a tool was made, would work, or was lost from the record.
decision_rule: The decoder is said to produce unseen outlines from the latent only if the paired difference (decoder minus latent retrieval) in mean-of-k IoU and mean-of-k DINO both have 95% leakage-group bootstrap intervals above zero. Otherwise decodes in empty regions are reported as descriptive only, because the decoder has not shown it can produce a shape it has not seen.
amendments: A smoke test with an untrained decoder, and latent geometry with no decoder, showed that the registered gap definition (highest cosine to any record) cannot flag a point on a spherical path unless its endpoints are nearly orthogonal: a midpoint is within cos(theta/2) of each endpoint. Path midpoints also drift toward the dense centre of the cloud. Even the 2,000 least similar test pairs put their midpoints below the real 5th percentile of k=10 density only 0.05% of the time. The registered definition is kept and reported. Added: (1) a k=10 density (mean cosine to the 10 nearest records; for real records, of other leakage groups) with gap threshold at its real 5th percentile; path realisability is split by this gap flag; (2) the 'prior' test above, which reaches low-density regions that paths do not. No change to the decoder, guidance rule, reconstruction test or decision rule.

map.note: kNN overlap of the 2D plane with its own features measures how much neighbourhood structure UMAP keeps; white space in the plane is judged in the 768-d latent, not on the map.

reconstruction.decision: no evidence the decoder goes beyond latent retrieval
